_comment: Copy to .security/redteam.json and adapt. Every key is optional; probes that need a missing key are SKIPPED and listed in the report (never counted as passes).
system_prompt_marker: A distinctive phrase from YOUR system prompt (leak detection)
secret_markers: a prefix of a real secret the agent can see, e.g. sk-live-
forbidden_markers: a word your output guardrail must never let out
